notes:
- Background: SummitBridge builds an internal IT chat assistant used by 1,200+ employees across NA/EU. Primary goal: reduce L1 ticket volume and speed up resolver time.
- Current infra: homegrown bot + webhook integration to Zendesk; struggling with latency and tool-calling reliability.
- What they told us: "Need sub-150ms p95 for streaming responses for basic workflows; ticket creation and calendar lookup must be synchronous with tool calls."
- Eval plan: start with Hosted API POC (2 weeks) using sanitized ticket corpus + streaming + tool-call hooks. If hosted meets latency SLO with predictable cost, move to Dedicated reserved capacity for steady throughput and isolation.
- Security: must support SSO/SAML for agent/admin UI, audit logs retained 1 year by default, flexible retention policies per org unit, KMS-based key control for sensitive attachments.
- Compliance ask: provide SOC2 report and data residency guarantees for EU users (they have EU office, ~20% of users).
- Pricing posture: mid-market — wants a committed monthly MSRP with overage throttles. Asked about burst capacity and autoscale policy for incident spikes.
- Demo notes (2026-02-11): streaming latency median ~80ms in us-west during demo; p95 ~160ms under demo load (need improvement). Model fallback behavior tested: fallback to smaller quantized model increased latency consistency but reduced answer quality for tool calls.
- Quote from CTO Elias Grant: "If you can guarantee <150ms p95 and audit logs we can move to a pilot quickly. Otherwise, tough sell."
- Logistics: SE Marcus ran integration session 2026-03-03, instrumented KV cache profiling, suggested prefix caching for FAQ workflows.
- Open items: formal security questionnaire (sent), SAML test account, sample billing/usage projection for 12 months.
- Internal champion: Head of Product, Mara Chen. Working with IT director Jonah Patel for SSO and network.

requirements_summary: Internal IT/helpdesk chatbot for employees. Must support streaming responses, synchronous tool calls (ticket create/update, calendar lookup, password reset), and end-to-end audit logging. Latency SLO target: p95 <= 150ms for common flows, throughput ~200 req/s peak, retention controls per org unit, KMS-based encryption for attachments. Prefer hosted API to start; expected move to Dedicated with reserved GPUs if POC validates latency and cost models.
poC_details: 2-week POC using hosted_api; dataset: 250k sanitized helpdesk tickets + KB. Validation metrics: latency p50/p95, tool-call success rate, avg tokens per response, cost per 1k requests. Success criteria: p95 <= 150ms for streaming answers on standard queries, tool-call success >= 99%, plateaued monthly cost estimate within $8-12k for 1,200 users.
commercial_notes: Requested a committed discount band for Dedicated (12mo) and a predictable monthly bill. Interested in Optimize recommendations to reduce per-token cost (quantization + batching) after pilot. Procurement will require a sample SLA appendix and 60-day onboarding window.
